notes.title: Art Contest WINNERS!!
notes.content:
For those of you seeing this game for the first time, it's 100% FREE and super-fun! We've crammed all the charm we could manage into the music and animations, we even created our own rudimentary drawing program inside the game's Main Menu which was the focus of this event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/ef397adff446a6249920fcf14df45bab1939f749.png

Here's all 5 winners for the #NEARDEADline art contest in order, their prizes have been sent out already, but we wanted to highlighted these super-special entries! We tasked out players to create an art piece using the in-game drawing tools and limited color palette within the game's Main Menu and this is the Top 5.


1st Place Winner ($80 Prize)
Artist: @Stelamoris1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/533a8363d946da2c5011f867edf9895b83b5840a.png

This one was a unanimous choice between us, it's original, it uses the limited palette for a great combination of colors, it has a nice perspective, and it has that canvas art feel that makes it really appealing to look at.


2nd Place Winner ($60 Prize)
Artist: @snailpirate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/0788c2a9c9c8a4b26566a46b415c817541c075fd.png

A nice homage to Evangelion in the composition, not to mention the details in the thin lines that require a fair bit of patience to get right.


3rd Place Winner ($30 Prize)
Artist: @Glob_Gallery
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/3168a80f2d9244764815f347a222d3a13239813d.png

An amazing monochromatic composition of a city drowned in clouds, this one won a lot of points for originality, exelect use of white space I might add.


4th Place Winner ($15 Prize)
Artist: @BenSalerno
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/fbfba060ea84e4e136abd13e177d32a01a6fcba9.png

We really like this one because of how many adorable creatures are jammed in this composition, it looks as though they're gathering to take a picture, it just looks fun to be there.


5th Place Winner ($15 Prize)
Artist: @WildsStuff
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/e75267c77a90aaf320f9c8d00d2590eaf25f3fc6.png

We love the concept that someone used Bob Ross' tutorial to draw this on the program, what it loses in originality it gains back in execution with the landscape.


We had some other really nice entries so be sure to check out the hashtag on Twitter and Follow these Individual artists. If they can do this well with our limited tool, they must be incredible with their preferred one!

notes.title: NEAR DEADline - Art Contest
notes.content:
NEAR DEADline is a game where you gotta keep an animator awake for 5 days to finish his deadline and to celebrate it's release on Steam, I wanted to have an Art Contest, so here's the deal:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/d162549aef0f54f953431e8c9c1b512455584384.png

Rules
[olist]
 Draw using the menu of the game
 Save it with the Camera icon (careful with the Clear icon, I heard in the past that some people lost drawings because of that)
 Tweet it with the hashtag #NEARDEADline to submit it[/olist]
Guidelines
 The drawing doesn’t have to be related to the game
 Keep it SFW
 Must be made in the main menu using its limited palettes provided in-game
 You can submit as many drawings as you want, just remember that “Quality > Quantity”
Judging 
 The judging will be done by the developers and here’s the things that we keep in mind:
Creativity (by that I mean how you use the brush of the game)
 That’s it
Prize Money
 1st - $80
 2nd - $60
 3rd - $30
 4th - $15
 5th - $15

Deadline (heh)
 August 31st
 I’ll send the prize money through Paypal so make sure you have one

Here's some examples if you want to get an idea of what to do
(credit to @irri, @Frenchporkybuns and @heyopc)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316137/c7a5327995dda1db666eac7f9be58420356a69dd.png

That should be it, hope everyone has fun doing this, can’t wait to see the submissions.
